messages:
sarah_newparent: Hi team  I'm returning from parental leave next week and my pediatrician recommended regular pumping breaks. Id like to request a dedicated lactation room or a guaranteed private lockable space and 30-45 minute breaks twice per day. Filing intake now.

people-ops: Thanks for the heads up, @sarah_newparent. Opening case HR-2026-998 to track. Looping @kevin_manager, @isabel_hr, and @facilities_ops.

lactation-bot: HR case HR-2026-998 created: "Lactation space and schedule accommodation". Intake link: https://hr.redwood.example/intake?case=HR-2026-998

kevin_manager: Sarah, welcome back early. We absolutely want to support this. Immediate question: do you want the breaks scheduled at consistent times, or flexible as-needed? I also have a couple deliverables next sprint; let's align so your pump times are predictable.

sarah_newparent: Prefer consistent windows if possible (mid-morning and mid-afternoon) so i can plan. I'm fine adjusting meeting times around them. Thank you.

isabel_hr: @sarah_newparent please complete the confidential intake or request a private call. HR will draft the accommodation agreement after intake (target 3 business days). Medical docs not required, but helpful. All health info stays confidential.

facilities_ops: Tagging workspace team  we can reserve a lockable lactation room (Room L2) and add a fridge and a rocking chair. Opening ticket FCL-2026-9622 for room prep and key code. ETA 2 business days.

ben_legal: Quick note: comply with state lactation laws and federal break requirements. Document options offered and the employees selection. Do not make accommodation contingent on performance. If performance issues exist, handle separately with documented coaching.

kevin_manager: On that separate note  Sarah, we had a few missed milestones before leave; that's unrelated to this request. I'll set clear deliverable owners and we can schedule your pump windows into the team's calendar so it's predictable. Happy to shift standups.

sarah_newparent: Appreciate it, Kevin. Predictable windows help a lot. I'll update my calendar and set out-of-office during those times.

people-ops: Summary/next steps: 1) Sarah completes HR intake for HR-2026-998; 2) Facilities to prep Room L2 (FCL-2026-9622) and install fridge/lock; 3) Manager and Sarah to align on fixed pump windows and update team calendar; 4) HR to draft accommodation agreement within 3 business days after intake. Please DM any private docs.

facilities_ops: Update: Room L2 reserved pending minor cleaning and lock code setup. We'll prioritize fridge delivery and signage. Please let us know if alternative space needed.

isabel_hr: Also noting payroll/benefits: pumping breaks are paid time per policy; if you need intermittent remote days for childcare, file separate remote-work request. HR can advise.

sarah_newparent: Thanks everyone. I'll do the intake tonight and share preferred windows (10:30-11:00 and 15:00-15:45). Also might ask for occasional remote half-days while kiddo has appointments.

ben_legal: One more: avoid posting photos of the lactation room or any medical info in channel. Keep documentation in the HR case and DMs.

kevin_manager: I'll block those windows on the team calendar and adjust sprint tasks. If any conflicts come up i'll work with the team to reassign.

people-ops: Noted. Case HR-2026-998 updated. Closing public thread once accommodation agreement is signed; DM for sensitive attachments. :heart:
